justifications.fit: the additions follow the module's private-helper and dataclass idiom (reckon/served_code.py:808-818) and introduce no plan, ticket or version token in a name or docstring.

justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 0cd2d5541..cbeb33e1a lists exactly the three declared sources plus the evidence fragment, with no out-of-scope edit.
